name: Evernote
verdict_reason: Trilium's tree-of-notes beats Evernote for structured thinkers on desktop. The mobile story is a synced web app and the OCR-of-photos job doesn't exist — worth it if your notes live on a keyboard.
what_you_lose: Native mobile apps with offline + camera capture — Trilium mobile is a web view
Evernote's OCR on photos and scans

what_broke: Project moved: zadam/trilium is archived, TriliumNext is the maintained fork — star counts and docker tags split across the two confuses every comparison
